title: Gabber finite cover of a modified closed image
statement: Let $g:F'\to S$ be a proper morphism of reduced Noetherian schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism], and let $F\subset S$ be its closed image with the reduced induced structure [def-weil-closed-immersion]. There exist a blowup $p:S'\to S$ with nowhere dense centre, which is a modification [def-trf-orgogozo-induction-data], and an $F$-scheme $G$ with an $F$-morphism $G\to F'$ and a finite surjective $F$-morphism $G\to F\times_S S'$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-pc-fibre-product].

source.place: Lemma 3.2.1, pp. 7--8 (Gabber). Local archival PDF WANTED; author PDF read online.
